notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone
We have another update package here, which we want to share with you.
A visual novel, as you can easily guess, needs a cool visual. And our artist Evgenia works tirelessly! The game has new scenes, as well as an updated interface — the arrow "next" has been dramatically transformed. Now it is decorated with an ancient Slavic ornament, which is closely related to the events of the game. So now the player, clicking on the arrow with the ancient symbol, as if guided by the way signs, will go deeper and deeper into the mysterious world of Navi day.

And the window text field itself has also acquired more interesting, more textured outlines, which is again the merit of Yevgenia. It is from such sometimes completely inconspicuous details that the style is formed. We really like it. We hope you will like it too.

A composer also joined our team. We were simply fascinated by his works, in which he mixes electronic sound with folk motifs like in a magic cauldron. The resulting potion, like on a helicopter carpet, takes the listeners into the atmosphere of a night forest smelling of pine needles and dampness. We will be adding music to the game very soon – we can't wait for you to hear it too.
See you soon!
